title: Severe Storms Hit Chicago
summary: Severe thunderstorms hit Chicago and the US Midwest on Tuesday, triggering tornado warnings and disrupting hundreds of flights. The storms cut power in the Chicago area and northwestern Indiana, causing extreme wind gusts across state lines. Tornado warning sirens blared in Illinois and Indiana, and all flights were stopped by late morning at Chicago. The severe weather grounded flights in Chicago and knocked out power in the region.
